note: No adjudicated variants: the two witnesses set this dismissal identically, letter for letter and point for point, including the capital M of Missa. What the witnesses do NOT share is coverage — do carries three further dismissals (the Easter form with allelúja, Benedicámus Dómino, Requiéscant in pace) which handmissal-eo does not print in Latin at all. Those are other dismissals rather than other readings of this one, so they are named in the rubrics of the text document, where the witness that attests each is recorded, and not encoded as words here.
